items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy.
lines: Four Indian states share the same birthday... today.
Before that, India's map was a patchwork: twenty-nine units, sorted into parts A, B, C and D.
[confused cartoon map of India, flustered] Wait... which part am I again?
Then in nineteen fifty-two, Potti Sreeramulu began a fast for a Telugu-speaking state.
Three days later, Nehru announced Andhra.
A commission then redrew the map along language lines.
And on the first of November, nineteen fifty-six, twenty-nine units became fourteen states and six union territories.
Born that day: Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, then the biggest state of all...
and Mysore State, which only became Karnataka in nineteen seventy-three.
[cartoon map of India, outraged] Hey! Who moved my border?!
And this year, Kerala turns seventy... with a new official name: Keralam.
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
